title: Mordern\_Circular\_Vase
author: oakliz27
description:
A modern, donut-shaped decorative vase with a smooth, continuous ring body and a large circular opening in the center. The design features a short cylindrical neck at the top for holding flowers, stems, or ornamental grasses. Its minimalist, sculptural form makes it perfect as a statement piece for contemporary interiors. Ideal for 3D printing in a variety of finishes to match your décor style.
